pieces.Text: At will as a free action, a shield archon can transform his hands into a +1 tower shield and a +3 shortspear, or either individually, or back to hands again.  He cannot transform both hands into shields or both into shortspears.  A shield archon never takes the typical -2 penalty on attack rolls while wielding a tower shield.  A shield archon's weapons cannot be disarmed, but they can be sundered.  If a shield archon loses his spear or shield, he can manifest a new one as a full-round action.  When a shield archon is slain, these two items fade away - they cannot be looted or wielded by any other creature.
